prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web homepage direction comp, landscape 16:10
Primary request: Design the complete first viewport of the Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar website for Lucena City in a “Swatch-to-Ledger Salon Counter” visual world. This is a real salon booking product, not a poster or photograph.
Scene/backdrop: a tactile salon front counter translated into a clear responsive web interface
Subject: service discovery that visibly becomes an appointment ticket shared by customer and staff
Style/medium: award-winning editorial product website UI mockup, production-realistic
Composition/framing: 1536-by-960-like landscape viewport; slim navigation with Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar at left and Services, Reviews, About, Login, Book at right; a large headline “Choose your treatment. Hold your time.”; a refined lacquer treatment swatch fan overlaps one decisive unbranded salon photograph; beside it, a crisp front-desk ledger strip lists treatments, price, duration and an “Open times” control; the selected swatch visibly becomes a visit ticket; primary action reads “Choose a treatment”; show real service facts: “Gel Polish — ₱1,500 · 60 min”, “Spa Treatment — ₱1,200 · 60 min”, “Lash Extension — ₱1,800 · 60 min”
Color palette: warm ticket stock #f4efe6, near-black ink #2b222b, lacquer plum #702a5d, lacquer blush #d66d7e, brushed stainless #aeb2b2
Materials/textures: lacquer swatches, carbon paper, uncoated ticket stock, brushed stainless steel; tactile but not kitschy
Text (verbatim): “Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar”; “Choose your treatment. Hold your time.”; “Choose a treatment”; “Gel Polish”; “₱1,500 · 60 min”; “Spa Treatment”; “₱1,200 · 60 min”; “Lash Extension”; “₱1,800 · 60 min”; “Open times”; “Visit ticket”
Constraints: first-time visitor immediately understands salon, real treatments, price, duration and booking; selected treatment becomes the same appointment-ticket grammar used across dashboards; use one dominant visual move and keep remaining regions calm; no third-party logos; no false ratings, counts, years, awards, certifications, hygiene claims, or exact address; this must read as a functional website
Avoid: generic rounded-card grid, ambient purple gradients, glassmorphism blur, vintage scrapbook clutter, excessive skeuomorphism, poster layout, illegible decorative text, watermark
